fit: fresh homogenized segments and felodipine bioavailability
assessment: Three grapefruit preparations increased felodipine exposure versus water. Preparation is verified for a different drug, with no cabergoline or resting-tremor result.

fit: fresh white grapefruit pulp with two calcium antagonists
assessment: Eight healthy men took fresh pulp in a crossover. The before-drug comparison gave about 1.3-fold exposure for each drug. This tests the culinary exposure with different substrates and no Parkinson outcome.
Two Parkinson cases described general improvement. One had a concentration near three times baseline. The author abstract contains no raw grapefruit or resting-tremor trajectory.

fit: original grapefruit juice and cabergoline pharmacokinetic graph
assessment: Figure 4 shows both concentration curves across hours 0–4, without a denominator, uncertainty or symptom outcome. Overlap with the earlier abstract is unconfirmed, so the reports share one provisional family.

fit: drug-level change with clarithromycin and selected motor outcomes
assessment: Seven Parkinson patients had 1.74-fold sampled plasma levels. Three improved on overall UPDRS, with resting tremor or rigidity mentioned and no separate item scores. The full paper proposes a transporter explanation; the added exposure is an antibiotic.
The pilot used the rest-tremor item and reports clinical improvement in its author abstract. Dose, comparator and numerical rest estimate need original tables. Grapefruit was outside the experiment.

fit: conversational reports with different grapefruit preparations and symptoms
assessment: A flavored sports drink was followed by little overall change and possible stiffness or pain after exercise. A separate participant reported eating grapefruit without a symptom outcome. A sugar-related tremor comment is a distinct exposure.

fit: grapefruit aroma with planned brain-signal and subjective endpoints
assessment: The official record specifies grapefruit essential oil aroma in a mixed-population crossover. Results and Parkinson subgroup counts are unavailable, and the route and outcome differ from the frozen comparison.

fit: isolated naringin and dopaminergic tissue in a rat model
assessment: The author abstract reports tissue preservation and changes in GDNF and inflammation after injected naringin. There is no fresh-fruit or separate rest outcome.
A separate mouse study reports tissue protection with pretreatment and no clear restoration with post-treatment. Resting tremor is described as clinical background.

fit: oral limonin and overall motor activity in a toxin model
assessment: The authored comparison reports improved general motor activity under an isolated citrus compound. The available report gives no separate rest-tremor estimate or fruit arm.

fit: isolated nootkatone and pole and rotarod motor proxies
assessment: The original behavioral endpoints were pole descent and rotarod retention after isolated injected nootkatone. Neither provides evidence for raw fruit on Parkinson resting tremor.
